🏗️ Java Ant Project Structure

Comprehensive testing for EJB services and Message-Driven Bean in Ant-based Java EE application

📁 Project Structure:

  • src/java/ - Source code (Entity, EJB, MDB, Servlet, Test)
  • web/ - Web resources (HTML, JSP, CSS)
  • web/WEB-INF/ - Configuration files
  • build/ - Compiled classes (generated)

📋 Test Instructions:

  1. Build Project: Use Ant build script to compile
  2. Deploy: Deploy to GlassFish server
  3. Automatic Tests: Will run on startup (check server logs)
  4. Interactive Tests: Use buttons above for manual testing
  5. Monitor: Check database changes in SQL Server Management Studio

🚀 Deployment URLs:

Local Application: http://localhost:8080/chiplap/

Test Suite: http://localhost:8080/chiplap/test/

MDB Tests: http://localhost:8080/chiplap/test-mdb

🔧 Ant Build Commands:

# Clean and build
ant clean compile

# Create WAR file  
ant war

# Deploy to GlassFish
ant deploy

# Run tests
ant test

✅ Expected Test Results:

  • EJB CRUD operations working correctly
  • Stock level monitoring functional
  • MDB processing alerts asynchronously
  • Database integration successful
  • Transaction processing with stock updates
